_source: PB-OS. Presets match konkr-game's fast / fastest / compat; the Compatible preset also takes Armada's (https://github.com/armada-os/armada, fex-profiles.json, GPL-2.0-or-later) memory-ordering and Multiblock settings.

fast.label: Fast
fast.description: x87 math at 64 bits instead of 80: a big win for older (DirectX 9-era) games. Safe for most games.

fastest.label: Fastest
fastest.description: Fast, without x86 memory-ordering emulation: the biggest CPU win, but multithreaded games can crash or glitch.

compatible.label: Compatible
compatible.description: Strict and slower, for games that crash or glitch.
